howto: Hold down to drill into the rock below your rig.
Dig into coloured ore to load it into your cargo hold.
Climb back to the surface: the load sells itself, and the tank and hull refill.
Spend cash in the surface shop on a faster drill, a bigger hold, more fuel and armour, then dig deeper.
tips: Fuel burns faster while you drill; turn back when the gold bar drops below a third.
Ore dug in a quick streak is worth up to 60% more: keep the STREAK counter going.
Lava first shows up in the Granite below 120 m and gets far more common deeper down. A Radiator from the shop cuts its burn.
Out of fuel you can still crawl, but the strain eats your hull. Climb, do not dig.
A wreck keeps your cash and upgrades; it only costs half the cargo you were carrying.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD to drill and move. Enter or Space starts from the title. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Hold the arrows on the on-screen pad. Tap a shop row to buy it.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title: Easy makes the tank last longer and hazards hit softer, Hard drinks fuel faster and hits harder. The mine itself also gets harder with depth: tougher rock, more lava and gas.

cheats.effect: The lamp lights the whole mine

features.difficulty: Easy / Normal / Hard buttons on the title, plus rock, lava and gas that get worse with depth
features.power-up-list: The surface shop lists all six upgrades (Drill, Cargo, Fuel tank, Hull, Radiator, Lamp) with level, effect and price
features.wave-or-level-counter: The HUD shows your depth and the rock layer you are in (Topsoil to Void)
features.high-score-table: Best hauls: the top five loads you have sold, with depth and date, on the title
features.results: A wreck opens the DRILL WRECKED card: this dive's depth, cargo lost, cash and deepest, with Dig again
features.tutorial: First dive: four prompts (drill down, grab ore, sell at the surface, buy an upgrade), each cleared by doing it; Skip, and Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint names the next useful move: sell a full hold, head up on low fuel, the upgrade you can afford, or the next ore layer
